card.fires_on: The word right before "attributed" or "attribute", such as "can be", "been", "previously" or "alt". It also fires on words before similar cause-assigning words like "traced" or "blamed".

card.writes: It strongly suppresses the word "attribute" and its variants, so it stops the model predicting "attribute" as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "attributed" or "attribute" and pushes the model away from predicting that word.
